title: Pan Theorem for Depth Zero Theta Lifts
body_html:
Pan Theorem for Depth Zero Theta Lifts

If \(\widetilde\pi'\) is the theta lift of \(\widetilde\pi\) and \(\widetilde\pi\) has depth-zero \(K\)-type \((x,\widetilde\rho)\), then there is an ordinary depth-zero \(K\)-type \((x,\rho)\) and a finite-field theta lift \((x',\rho')\) such that the covering-group \(K\)-types are obtained through the generalized lattice-model splitting. Conversely, any such finite-field lifted pair occurs in the corresponding lattice-model subspace.
proof_html: The paper imports this from Pan. It identifies depth-zero local theta lifting with finite-field oscillator correspondence on the residue spaces \(\ell,\ell^\ast,\ell',\ell'^\ast\), with the covering-group splittings supplied by \(B_{x,x'}\).

deps.title: Depth Zero Theta Lift via Finite Fields
